conceptZh: 積木小隊中，最大的積木扯開嗓子，小積木被吼到疊成「叫」。
object: a squad of interlocking toy bricks with one tiny red brick and one giant blue brick
morph: size-mismatched bricks stack into 叫 as the tiny brick's shout topples the tower
creativeAngle: 最小的積木發出巨大叫聲，把大積木吹得疊成字。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a pale sky-blue backdrop with a thin white floor line. Lead: a squad of chunky interlocking toy bricks marching in a line, with one tiny red brick and one huge blue brick. The finished glyph 叫 is built of bright saturated red and blue bricks, centered, about 70% of frame height.
0.0-1.7s: the bricks march in; the tiny red brick tries to stack on the giant blue brick and can only reach its ankle. First "叫" as the tiny brick opens a round mouth.
1.7-3.3s: size mismatch: the tiny one climbs a ramp of small bricks, the huge one bends down and they bump heads; the tower wobbles. Second "叫" lands as the tiny brick climbs on the giant's shoulders, takes a breath and squeaks a giant shout that makes the giant blue brick's studs pop up.
3.3-5.0s: the shout-wave blows the bricks flat, they land by chance as the glyph 叫, with a loud clatter of plastic.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still. At "大叫" the huge blue brick tilts back and opens a massive mouth and the tiny red brick copies, both mouths wide open, little sound waves drifting outward, then both laugh and bounce at the edges of the frame.
Audio: Off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "叫、叫、大叫" (ㄐㄧㄠˋ、ㄐㄧㄠˋ、ㄐㄧㄠˋ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 叫.
No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.
